name: Hulk Phone Guard for WooCommerce
author: hulkplugins

sections.description:
Hulk Phone Guard for WooCommerce validates international phone numbers directly in the block-based WooCommerce checkout and on the My Account Edit Address page. It ships with a country selector, live formatting, custom error messages, duplicate phone detection, and handy order phone management tools for store admins.

Product Overview

Documentation

Features

Checkout & My Account Validation
* International phone number validation at block-based checkout and on the My Account > Edit Address page
* Country selector with search, flags, and auto-detection via geo-IP lookup
* Format phone numbers as you type with configurable display format (International, National, E.164, RFC3966)
* Strict validation with configurable allowed number types (Mobile, Fixed Line, Toll Free, VoIP, etc.)
* Fully customizable validation error messages for each error type
* “Always allow checkout” option so customers can complete an order even when their number is invalid

Admin Order Management
* Detect and warn about duplicate phone numbers across orders in the admin order edit screen
* One-click Call, WhatsApp, SMS, and Copy buttons on order screens and the order preview modal
* Phone numbers block included in order emails with WhatsApp and SMS links for admins
* Respects your existing phone field visibility (hidden, optional, or required) and warns you if the field is disabled on the Checkout block

User Profile & Settings
* Phone validation on WordPress user profile and edit user screens in admin
* Multi-language support for the validation UI
* Compatible with modern WooCommerce block-based checkout
* Debug logging via WooCommerce Status > Logs

Note: This is the free version of the plugin. Some advanced features are available in the Pro version.

External Services

This plugin connects to various APIs to obtain geolocation information, it’s needed to show the user’s country based on their IP address. Below is a detailed list of the external services used, along with the data sent, usage details, and links to their terms of service and privacy policies.

  1. ipapi.co

    • Purpose: Used to retrieve geolocation data such as the user’s country based on their IP address.
    • Data Sent: User’s IP address.
    • When Sent: Every time the geolocation functionality is accessed.
    • Terms of Service: ipapi.co Terms
    • Privacy Policy: ipapi.co Privacy Policy

  2. geojs.io

    • Purpose: Retrieves the user’s country information based on their IP address.
    • Data Sent: User’s IP address.
    • When Sent: Whenever geolocation data is required.
    • Terms of Service: GeoJS Terms
    • Privacy Policy: GeoJS Privacy Policy

  3. ip.guide

    • Purpose: Retrieves the user’s country information based on their IP address.
    • Data Sent: User’s IP address.
    • When Sent: Whenever geolocation data is required.
    • Terms of Service: IP Guide Terms
    • Privacy Policy: IP Guide Privacy Policy

  4. BigDataCloud.net

    • Purpose: Performs reverse geocoding to convert geographic coordinates into readable location information.
    • Data Sent: User’s IP address and/or geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).
    • When Sent: Whenever reverse geocoding is required.
    • Terms of Service: BigDataCloud Terms
    • Privacy Policy: BigDataCloud Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Login to your admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search Hulk Phone Guard for WooCommerce
  4. Click install and activate respectively.

Manual Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

If your server is not connected to the Internet, then you can use this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Login to your site’s admin panel and navigate to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload.
  3. Click choose file, select the plugin file and click install

Install Using FTP

If you are unable to use any of the methods due to internet connectivity and file permission issues, then you can use this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Launch your favorite FTP client. Such as FileZilla, FireFTP, CyberDuck etc. If you are a more advanced user, then you can use SSH too.
  4. Upload the folder to wp-content/plugins/
  5. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Navigate to Plugins -> Installed
  7. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with classic WooCommerce checkout?

No. This plugin is designed specifically for the modern WooCommerce block-based checkout.

Can I choose which countries customers can select from?

Yes. You can limit the list to specific countries, exclude certain countries, and control the initial country and its ordering directly from the settings page.

Can I customize the validation error messages?

Yes. Every validation error (too short, too long, invalid country code, invalid number, invalid type) can be customized from the settings page.

Where is the phone number validated?

The plugin validates phone numbers on the block-based checkout page and on the My Account > Edit Address page, so customers get the same validation everywhere they update their number.

How does the duplicate phone warning work?

When editing an order in the admin, the plugin checks whether the billing phone already appears on other orders (within the last year, up to 20 results) and shows a warning listing those orders, so you can investigate suspicious or repeated phone numbers. Orders from the same customer are excluded from the warning.

What phone number formats are supported?

The plugin uses Google’s libphonenumber library to validate and format numbers according to international standards. It supports E.164, International, National, and RFC3966 display formats.

Can I allow customers to checkout with invalid numbers?

Yes. The “Always allow checkout” setting lets customers complete their order even if the phone number fails validation. Invalid numbers are still logged for admin review.

Does the plugin work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and legacy order storage.
